name: Astral Frontier Online
storyline:
The Astral Frontier has opened.

No one knows why. No one knows who - or what - caused it. Yet the world has been forced to accept a new reality.

Creatures from the Astral Realm, known as Asters, now cross into the mortal world with increasing frequency. Once believed to be divine beings, humanity has learned a terrifying truth: not all Asters are benevolent.

Among them are the Daemons - corrupted Asters driven by ambition and chaos. Many believe they are responsible for the fracture between worlds, seeking to transform Earth into a new dominion where they no longer have to bow to the ancient authority of the Daevas, the benevolent guardians of the Astral Realm.

As the boundary between worlds continues to weaken, monsters emerge, civilizations tremble, and the balance of reality itself begins to unrave... A new generation of adventurers must rise. Alongside their own Asters, they will uncover the truth behind the Astral Frontier, confront the forces threatening both realms, and decide whether the fate of their world can still be changed - or whether the two realities are destined to become one.
summary: An indie anime-style MMORPG in development
